caption.en: The saved 35 x 35 saddle matrix for velocity size 24.

name.ja: 有限次元線形方程式と行列分解

note.ja: 有限行列Aと右辺bの代数問題です。LU/Cholesky・混合精度改良・対称不定値鞍点系を固定例で検査し、連続PDEの解とは区別します。
note.en: Finite matrices A and right-hand sides b define algebraic problems. Fixed LU, Cholesky, refinement and symmetric-indefinite saddle controls are distinct from continuum PDE solutions.

equation_note.ja: 速度12/24、圧力5/11の代数的混合Poisson/Stokes型ブロック。元の真の残差1e-9を共通基準にします。
equation_note.en: Algebraic mixed-Poisson/Stokes-type blocks with velocity sizes 12 and 24 and pressure sizes 5 and 11. The common original-system residual tolerance is 1e-9.

name.ja: 対称不定値鞍点系とSchur前処理
name.en: Symmetric saddle systems and Schur preconditioning

note.ja: 同じ元残差の基準でMINRESとGMRESを比較し、理想Schurの三点スペクトルを検査します。
note.en: MINRES and GMRES use the same original-system residual criterion and are checked against the ideal Schur three-point spectrum.

title.ja: 対称不定値鞍点系：独立dense解と理想Schurスペクトル
title.en: Symmetric saddles: independent dense solutions and the ideal-Schur spectrum

references.formula: S=B H^{-1} B^T; P=diag(H,S); spectrum(L^{-1} A L^{-T})={1,(1-sqrt(5))/2,(1+sqrt(5))/2}; x_ref=LAPACK_solve(A,b)

assumptions.ja: A=[[H,Bᵀ],[B,0]]、速度サイズ12/24、圧力行数5/11の代数問題。SPD理想Schurは全行列を小さく直接構成し、元の真残差とdense参照解誤差を別に判定。実Stokes境界値問題ではありません。
assumptions.en: Algebraic saddles A=[[H,B^T],[B,0]] use velocity sizes 12 and 24 and pressure sizes 5 and 11. Explicit dense SPD ideal-Schur controls compare the original residual separately with dense-solution error. This is not a Stokes boundary-value PDE.

note.ja: 理想Schurは教育用の稠密制御であり、実Stokes PDEやスケーラブルな近似前処理の完成ではありません。
note.en: A dense, ideal-Schur educational control, not a complete Stokes PDE solver or a scalable approximate preconditioner.

reference_note.ja: LAPACK全系解、理想Schurの3点スペクトル、CGの明示的負曲率対照。
reference_note.en: Global LAPACK solutions, the analytic ideal-Schur spectrum and an explicit negative-curvature control for CG.

name.ja: 対称不定値系の教育用MINRES

method_note.ja: 全基底保存のLanczos最小残差LSと二重MGS GMRES。SPD合同変換で対称性を保持。 元入力の残差1e-9と固定前進上限2e-8から、行列のみのκ∞推定で内部目標min(rtol,2e-8/κ∞)を導出。独立解を停止に使わない。
method_note.en: Stored-basis Lanczos least squares provides the educational MINRES variant; GMRES uses two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt. An SPD congruence preserves symmetry. The internal target is min(configured rtol, fixed forward-error limit / kappa_infinity), using only the matrix. The independent solution is not a stopping input.
